source_map.note: Per-SKU page https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/sku/<id>/specifications.html (the slug after the id may be omitted; a plain request reads it). Rows: 'Code Name Products formerly <name>', 'Vertical Segment Desktop|Mobile|Workstation', 'Launch Date Qn'yy', 'Sockets Supported <socket>'. Ids can be guessed by scanning near a known id (neighbouring ids are sibling SKUs of one launch); page.py prints the 'Processor Number' to identify them. Some ids answer 403: skip them.

Same page: 'Total Cores 24 # of Performance-cores 8 # of Efficient-cores 16 Total Threads 32' (Meteor Lake / Arrow Lake add '# of Low Power Efficient-cores'). Pre-12th-gen and Core X / Xeon W-2200: 'Total Cores 4 Total Threads 8'.

Same page: 'Instruction Set Extensions', only SSE4.1 / SSE4.2 / AVX / AVX2 / AVX-512 / AMX. Nothing finer (AVX-VNNI, FMA3, F16C, AVX512 sub-extensions, AMX-INT8/BF16) on any of the ~85 product pages opened. Searched for an Intel page per processor family: only PDFs (programming reference, AMX brief: unreadable here) and the developer article 'accelerate-tensorflow-ml-performance-amx' (no AMX-INT8/BF16 text on the page). Not found.

Same page 'Memory Types': 'DDR4-2666'; 'Up to DDR5 5600 MT/s Up to DDR4 3200 MT/s'; Xeon W: 'DDR5-4800 (MT/s) Maximum Memory Speed 4800 MT/s'. Speed differs by model inside a generation: boundaries found by opening middle models, see rows.
Same page: 'Max # of Memory Channels 2', 'Max Memory Size (dependent on memory type) 128 GB'.

Same page 'Max Memory Bandwidth 41.6 GB/s' on 8th to 14th gen desktop, Core X, Xeon W-2200, 13980HX. Absent on 7th gen, Core Ultra (all), Xeon W-2400/3400, 13th-gen U/P/H and HX other than 13980HX: derived there where one DDR speed applies, else null.
Same page 'GPU Name'. The value sits after footnote markup, so quote as 'GPU Name | <value>'. Absent on Core X and Xeon W.

Same 'Memory Types' row; older mobile pages list 'DDR4-2400, LPDDR3-2133'; Xeon W-3100/3200 give 'Maximum Memory Speed 2666 MHz'; Xeon W-2100 'DDR4 1600/1866/2133/2400/2666'; Tiger Lake-H gives only 'Up to 3200 MT/s'.
